identity: Mono-black aristocrats: a low-curve deck where every body is worth something when it dies. Falkenrath Torturer sacrifices for free and without limit, Demonic Taskmaster sacrifices for free every upkeep whether you like it or not, and Village Rites turns a dying body into two cards. Blood Artist and The Meathook Massacre convert each death into drain while Morbid Opportunist converts it into cards. The clock is not the drain, though - it is 8 flying power across two Demonic Taskmasters plus a 2/2 flier every turn from Bloodline Keeper, with the drain as the reach that finishes. Seventeen Swamps, no fixing, no rare spent on mana. Edgar's Awakening is the Reanimator residue and it earns its slot only because Demonic Taskmaster (4/3) and Distended Mindbender (5/5) gave the deck something worth returning - before them the biggest creature in the list had 2 power.
